items.title: Len Manno Interview, 1959-02-06
items.q: I never worked with peck regular but I I was the first substitute whenever his regular bass player took off well he'd hire me to replace him

ctx.x: in any style that approaches him or does he have a good copyist like say red camp did you ever hear red camp

nobody plays like Kelly and that's let's put it like this I've listened to to so many of these people that that have tremendous reputations and of course they all probably have their little nick and in the history and the progress of jazz but I feel that while some of them were considered considered the greatest as compared to some of the modern day fellas I think the music has come a long way and while I think that that pet Kelly is a very important deal as far as pianist go I think there are some fellas today…
